nuggets.text: Deshawn Purdie's first college start came against Gardner-Webb, as a Charlotte freshman in 2024.
Deshawn Purdie threw for 230 yards and a touchdown with no interceptions in the Flames' opener at James Madison.
The Flames have three running backs on the Doak Walker Award watch list: Kam Davis, Peyton Jones and Kayne Udoh.
Flames center Aaron Fenimore is a HERO Sports Group of Six preseason All-American, second team.
The Spirit of the Mountain Marching Band is debuting a special 'Give Me Liberty' tribute this season.
Jamey Chadwell was the 2020 AP Coach of the Year after leading Coastal Carolina to an 11-0 start.
Jamey Chadwell led the Flames to an undefeated 2023 regular season, a C-USA title and a Fiesta Bowl trip.
The Flames cracked the AP Top 25 for the first time ever in 2020, at No. 25.
The Flames' fight song is called 'Fan the Flames!'
The Flames won the last meeting with Gardner-Webb, 21-20, in 2022.
